verdict.rationale: WorkOS doesn't ship a built-in chat-style AI assistant inside its dashboard, but it does expose an official MCP server that lets connected AI agents 'read and change the same dashboard data you can (managing organizations, connections, users, branding, and more)' — effectively delegating admin tasks to an AI agent, just via an external MCP client rather than an embedded assistant UI. Probe evidence confirms the MCP endpoint is live and auth-gated. Missing for 10: a native in-product assistant/chat interface, first-party UI for delegating tasks without a separate MCP client, and independent hands-on confirmation of agent task completion.
